player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
A ka kɛ {symbol}, ka kelenw ta ye {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 walima O2, O4).

Dɔɔnin: Kɛɲɛ ni kɛɛnɛ ka kelenw tɛɛnɛ sɔrɔ (a ka bɔnɛ ka superpositions).

Niyɛɛnɛ:
- Kɛɲɛ kelen, sigi ka spooky mark ye filɛ kelenw ye ka tɛɛnɛ '[a,b]' ka fɔrmɛ.
- A ka marks ye entangled, ka kelenw ye 'X1 / X1' walima 'O4 / O4'.
- I ka tɛɛnɛ spooky marks ye filɛ kelenw ka bɔnɛ ka collapsed (solidified).

Collapse Rule:
- Ni a ka kɛɲɛ kɛɛnɛ cycle ye entanglement graph, a ka collapse tɔɔ.
- Kɛɲɛ spooky mark ye cycle ka bɔnɛ ka classical mark ye filɛ kelenw.
- Ni dependent spooky marks ka bɔnɛ, a ka collapse.

Kɛɲɛ:
- Dɔɔnin kɛɛnɛ ni player kelen kɛɛnɛ classical marks tɛɛnɛ sɔrɔ.
- Ni player wɛɛ kɛɛnɛ line ye collapse kelen, a ka min max move number kɛɛnɛ kɛɛnɛ.

Example move: '[0,4]' sigi ka spooky mark ye cells 0 ka 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nin ye cogoya fufafu le ye. Aw ka nin tagamasiɲɛ ta: "[a,b]".
invalid_move.already_solidified: Filɛ kelen ye ka bɔnɛ ka solidified.

game_action.placed: Jɛkulu {player_id} daa jɛkulu in ye so daɲɛ ma so {pos_a} ni {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition bɔnɛ. Filɛ ({r}, {c}) ye ka {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition ye last cell bɔnɛ. Filɛ ({r}, {c}) ye ka {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ ka ca. Kɔnɔ ({r}, {c}) ye {symbol}.

outcome.win: Ɲininkɛla {player_id} be se ka see sɔrɔ n'a ye a makiri kɛ!
outcome.draw: U bɛɛ bɛnna a la ko an tɛna bɔnɛ foyi sɔrɔ.
